full_prompt_en: A square cinematic interior image shows a lone figure seated low on a broad staircase while strong daylight enters from tall windows at the upper left. The room is large and mostly dark, its walls receding into charcoal green-gray shadow. A curved stair railing rises from the center and sweeps toward the upper right, where a row of closely spaced dark balusters makes a repeating vertical pattern. A small arched window is visible high on the back wall. The seated person appears near the lower left of center, wearing a dark suit-like outfit. The body faces roughly forward, one arm resting across a bent knee, but the face stays mostly in shadow and cannot be read in detail. Several broad pale shafts descend diagonally from the upper-left window through visible haze. Their crisp bright cores cross the railing and reach the floor in warm-edged patches near the bottom. Narrower light bars create alternating brightness on the steps, while the space behind the person remains almost black. The huge window panes glow white, contrasted with the small human silhouette and the dark enclosing architecture. The image has a photographic or highly rendered cinematic finish, with smooth shadow transitions and distinct volumetric rays rather than painted brush marks. The light organizes the space more strongly than furniture or ornament, turning the stair curve into a sweeping boundary between brightness and darkness. Large shadow areas, repeated railings, and falling beams give the still pose solemn theatrical weight.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感室内图像描绘一位孤身人物坐在宽阔楼梯低处，强烈日光从左上高窗进入。房间很大，大部分深暗，墙面退入炭绿灰阴影。弯曲楼梯扶栏从中央升起，扫向右上，密排深色栏杆形成重复的竖向纹样。后墙高处可见一扇小拱窗。坐着的人位于下方中央稍左，穿深色西装般的衣服。身体大致向前，一条手臂搁在弯曲膝上，但面孔大多藏在阴影里，细节难辨。几道宽阔浅色光束从左上窗斜落，穿过可见的雾气。明亮核心横穿扶栏，在底部地面形成带暖边的光斑。更窄的光条在台阶上制造明暗交替，人物后面的空间则近乎黑色。巨大窗格发白，与小人剪影和围拢的暗建筑相对。图像具有摄影或高度渲染的电影表面，阴影过渡平滑，体积光束明确，而不是绘画笔触。光比家具或装饰更有力地组织空间，使楼梯曲线成为亮与暗之间的扫动边界。大片暗影、重复栏杆和下落光束赋予静止姿态庄重的戏剧重量。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic low-key rendering divides a large dark space with a few high-intensity directional beams. Cool charcoal and green-gray shadow occupy the majority, while pale window light forms diagonal shafts, small floor pools, and bars across stepped surfaces. Haze makes the rays volumetric without erasing crisp architectural edges near the source. A curved boundary and repeated vertical lines guide the eye through the depth, and a small dark focal mass gains scale from the surrounding void. Light is selective, leaving interior detail unreadable outside its path. The composition feels solemn through large value ratios, measured geometry, and luminous air.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感低调渲染以少数高强度定向光束切分大块暗空间。冷炭色与绿灰阴影占据多数，浅色窗光形成斜向光柱、小地面光池和横过阶梯平面的光条。雾气使光线有体积，却没有抹去靠近光源处清楚的建筑边缘。一道弯曲边界和重复竖线引导目光穿过纵深，小小暗色焦点体块从周围空洞获得尺度。光有选择地照明，路径之外的内部细节不可读。巨大的明暗面积比例、克制几何和发亮空气令构图庄重。
theme_en: A lone seated figure on a staircase beneath crossing window beams
theme_zh: 孤身人物坐在楼梯上，窗光束从上方交错落下
name: Dramatic lighting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
